task: There is RNA-seq 10X Cell Ranger data and BCR-seq data from 2 patients (use filtered contig annotations). You can find metadata related to the patients in the metadata.csv file. For each patient, two measurements was taken: one before influenza vaccination (e.g. 09-0) and the other 7 days after the vaccination (e.g. 09-7). Load the data, perform preprocessing and quality control. Keep only cells with single BCR chain pair. Keep only cells for which both BCR and RNA-seq data exist. Annotate cell types using cell_type.py script. Using iggytop, perform antigen species enrichment. Find the most abundant antigen species across all samples (ignore ambiguous). For Influenza A virus, across all samples, what are the 3 most common targets (antigen name)?
